title: Distinguish portfolio surveys from score optimization outcomes
description:
As an optimization operator, I want portfolio surveys and score optimizer executions to be unmistakably different, so that a completed survey is never interpreted as a successfully improved score.

Feature: Optimization execution clarity

Scenario: Account-wide portfolio survey has not launched an optimizer
  Given a portfolio procedure has surveyed and assessed scores
  And it has launched no score optimizer
  When an operator views the procedure or its Report
  Then the interface labels it as a portfolio survey
  And it shows zero optimizer launches and zero successful improvements
  And it does not imply that any score was optimized

Scenario: Portfolio run launches score optimizers
  Given a portfolio procedure has selected and launched exact score targets
  When an operator views the procedure or its Report
  Then the interface shows the funnel from surveyed through diagnosed, selected, launched, evaluated, and improved
  And score optimizer children are visually distinct from the parent portfolio survey

Scenario: Completed procedure has no improvement evidence
  Given a procedure task is completed
  But it has no terminal evaluation and safe-improvement review evidence
  When the operator views its outcome
  Then the interface does not call the score optimized or improved

Out of scope: changing selection policy, launching new optimizers, promotion, schema resources, or operational mutations.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Live production-backed evidence showed multiple completed account-level portfolio procedures with zero score-linked optimizer children and zero evaluations. The current interface makes those records look like optimizations. Work begins with outside-in dashboard specifications for explicit survey labeling and a surveyed-to-improved execution funnel.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implemented the first clarity increment. Portfolio parent Procedures and linked Report subtitles now identify the work as an optimization opportunity survey. The Report adds a seven-stage visual funnel: surveyed, assessed, diagnosed, selected, launched, evaluated, and validated improvement. Zero-launch runs explicitly state that no score optimizer launched and that survey completion is not score improvement. The funnel uses container-responsive columns so it remains readable in the narrow split Report view. Validation: 224 portfolio/report Python tests passed; 59 focused dashboard behavior tests passed; 21 related Report/Procedure dashboard tests passed; full dashboard typecheck passed. Live local rendering against production-backed read-only data confirmed the new labels, exact historical counts, zero-launch explanation, responsive funnel, and consistent Report-list subtitles. No schema, resource, production mutation, optimizer launch, or champion change was introduced.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Added failing and passing specifications so automatic-mode report narration describes policy selection and zero-launch exclusions without implying human approval. Approval-required narration remains unchanged. Focused stakeholder-overview suite: 5 passed.
